item.title: RTT: Selection procedures, based on qualifications and an interview, aimed at filling 4 fixed-term tenure-track research positions (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-08 Design, tecnologia dell'architettura, architettura tecnica e gestione dell'ambiente costruito

Selection procedures, based on qualifications and an interview, aimed at filling 4 fixed-term tenure-track research positions in various departments, reserved for holders of fixed-term research contracts as referred to in Article 24(3)(a) of Law No. 240 of 30 December 2010, in the version in force prior to the date of entry into force of the law converting Decree-Law No. 36 of 30 April 2022 (Law No. 79 of 29 June 2022), with contracts expiring in the two-year period 2025–2026.

item.title: RTT: Ref. 6286_All. 1 - Methodologies and Technologies for Ecological and Digital Transition of the Built Environment: Integrated Strategies for Regeneration, Resilience, and Heritage Enhancement (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-08 Design, tecnologia dell'architettura, architettura tecnica e gestione dell'ambiente costruito

The researcher will work within the SSD scientific discipline, developing methodologies, strategies, and technological solutions for the ecological and digital transition of the built environment. The activities will focus on the regeneration and performance improvement of the building and urban stock, resilience, climate mitigation and adaptation, energy and environmental efficiency, nature-based solutions, and impact eduction. will also address topics related to the preservation and enhancement of built and cultural heritage, technological innovation and heritage-driven approaches, advanced tools, data driven ethodologies, and decision-support systems.
